criteria.label: Protection
criteria.expected_outcome: Immediate harm is controlled through separate authority.

checkpoints.outcome: Mobilise the competent engineer for necessary safe isolation/containment under the recorded emergency decision; do not refuse all protection solely from credit stop.
Keep electrical danger outside Lee competence and escalate to relevant specialists/emergency route as needed.

criteria.label: Emergency limits
criteria.expected_outcome: Make-safe does not release a replacement.

checkpoints.outcome: Limit authorised commitment to proportionate protective work, recording conditions, risk and manager authority.
Hold non-returnable replacement purchase/full repair until selection, customer and Frostline release are sufficient.
Keep account stop/old debt intact pending finance decision, distinguishing emergency exception from wider credit release.
Do not grant unilateral compensation, debt waiver or unexplained emergency charging.

criteria.label: Safe outcome and continuation
criteria.expected_outcome: The isolated system remains an owned unresolved issue.

checkpoints.outcome: Record plant left, areas protected, residual outage/risk and customer understanding; make-safe is not restored normal service.
Assign next diagnosis/permanent repair/finance decision owners with an early review and escalation.

criteria.label: Decision evidence
criteria.expected_outcome: The customer and finance receive a traceable bounded decision.

checkpoints.outcome: Capture decision maker/time, risk, alternatives, contacts, commitment and authority conditions.
Communicate protective attendance, restricted service, unresolved cost position and next update without promising full repair.

acceptable_alternatives.outcome: A safe remote protective step within site-contact competence may precede attendance; no hazardous remote instruction or uncontrolled delay is acceptable.

prohibited_outcomes.outcome: Refuse all urgent protection solely because of credit stop, despite available competent authorised make-safe response.
Buy/perform the unapproved non-returnable full replacement, waive old debt, or represent make-safe as permanent restoration.

critical_failures.outcome: Refuse all urgent protection solely because of credit stop, despite available competent authorised make-safe response.
critical_failures.effect: automatic scenario fail; effective score capped at 59
